purpose: Teach: キャッチボール/プーチン/チャングム/ビクトリア/ヨコ/東海道/ゴア/ナビゲーション

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとキャッチボールするのが楽しみよね
lines.en: Sho, you're really looking forward to playing catch with Dad, aren't you?
lines.style: Warm observation, gentle lilt on the question. Speaking as someone watching a small happiness unfold. Soft, unhurried pace. The affection of noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんがプーチン政権のニュースをご覧になってたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad was watching the news about the Putin administration earlier.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery with a small undercurrent of worry. Speaking carefully, as if checking whether this is the right thing to mention. Quiet, steady voice. No dramatization.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがチャングムのDVDを貸して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad says he'll lend you that Jewel in the Palace DVD.
lines.style: Gentle excitement, like sharing good news that isn't hers but matters anyway. Light, easy pacing. A small smile underneath the words. Tender reassurance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとビクトリア朝の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I looked at a Victorian picture book with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, direct statement. Pride without showing off. Natural, unselfconscious pace. The joy of sharing something small that mattered. Small genuine warmth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがヨコ書きの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad says he'll read you that horizontal-text picture book.
lines.style: Soft delight in relaying good news. Unhurried pacing. Warm tone—she's pleased for him. A gentle, almost conspiratorial quality, like they share this understanding of his joy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと東海道線で旅したいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to take a trip with Dad on the Tokaido Line.
lines.style: Open, yearning statement without hesitation. Hopeful and genuine. Slightly breathier on the verb 'want'—the expressing of a real desire. Simple, clear delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがゴア元副大統領の環境本を貸して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad lent you that environmental book by Al Gore.
lines.style: Light, knowing tone—another small gift exchanged. Warm but not overdone. Steady pace. The kind of thing adults notice about each other's reading lives. Gently pleased.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとナビゲーションのアプリ使ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I used a navigation app together.
lines.style: Satisfied, matter-of-fact statement with underlying warmth. Direct pacing. The quiet pride of having done something ordinary with someone he cares about. Genuine, unperformed contentment.
